identity_link_conflict: This external identity is already linked. Choose another identity or review your existing links.
last_login_method: Keep at least one usable login method. Add another method before unlinking this identity.
invalid_request: The federation request is invalid or its login state is missing, expired, or replayed. Restart sign-in and complete it in one browser session.
provider_not_found: The requested identity provider does not exist. Refresh the provider list and choose an existing provider.
provider_issuer_exists: An identity provider for this issuer already exists in the tenant. Choose a different issuer or update the existing provider.
provider_role_missing: The provider default role does not exist in this tenant. Choose a role that exists or clear the default role.
provider_disabled: This identity provider is disabled. An administrator must enable it before you can sign in with it.
provisioning_disabled: This identity provider cannot provision new accounts. An administrator must create your account and link it to the identity provider first.
identity_unavailable: The linked account or its tenant membership is disabled. Contact an administrator to restore access.
email_unverified: Automatic account provisioning requires a verified email address from the identity provider. Ask an administrator to check the provider claims or provision the account manually.
oidc_failed: The identity provider rejected or could not complete the sign-in. Restart sign-in and try again; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
unavailable: The federation service could not complete the request. Retry later; contact an administrator if the problem continues.
saml_invalid_request: The SAML request is malformed, expired, or was sent to the wrong destination. Restart the sign-in or logout flow from the application.
saml_invalid_sp: The SAML service provider metadata is invalid. Check the XML, entity ID, and assertion consumer binding, then register it again.
saml_sp_not_found: The SAML service provider does not exist. Refresh the registry and choose an existing provider.
saml_sp_entity_id_exists: A SAML service provider with this entity ID is already registered. Choose a different entity ID or update the existing provider.
saml_sp_disabled: This SAML service provider is disabled. An administrator must enable it before it can use the identity provider.
saml_unavailable: The SAML identity provider is not available. Enable the SAML federation configuration and retry.
saml_key_managed_externally: The SAML signing key is managed through configuration files. Rotate it by replacing the key and certificate files instead.
